title: Page 2
content_zh:
温暖是温宁的二姊，在他们结婚前就看肖崇源不顺眼，离婚后更是处处刁难，几次动用温家的势力，明里暗里找肖氏企业的麻烦。
不过又没有造成什么大损失，他也太斤斤计较、小心眼了，“事情都已经过去两年了……”
“很抱歉，我的记忆力一向很好。”
“那拜托你也想起当初温家对你的好。”
“你倒是提醒了我。”肖崇源恍然大悟般点点头，彻底敛去所有虚伪的笑意，“在温家为了和肖氏联姻而选择骗婚的时候，有想过公私分明吗？”
“你……”温宁不可置信地看着他，忍无可忍，“你真是一点都没变。”
肖崇源轻轻一笑，“你和婚前相比倒是变化很大。”
温宁成功地被他激怒，像只发怒的小猫一样，差一点就要把爪子抓到他脸上了，“过了这么久，你居然还拿这件事来说，你真是我所见过的最最最最最最小气的男人了！”
肖崇源也站了起来，隔着办公桌与她对峙，“你这个女人知道自己在和谁大呼小叫吗？”
温宁伸长了脖子，“说到底，是我被你温柔的外表骗了才对，如果不是爸妈喜欢你，我才不会这么轻易就嫁给你这个小气鬼。”
“你以为我很愿意娶你吗？”
“所以我们不是离婚了嘛，我也不想再见到你！”
“那你还出现在这里做什么？”
温宁被噎住，愣了一会暗叫糟糕，她怎么忘记自己是来干什么的了！
剑拔弩张的两个人瞬间收了声，一时间没有人再说话，熟悉的争吵让两个人都情不自禁想到了过往，那时他们也是这样吵个不停，而吵架的内容也和刚刚如出一辙。
温宁和肖崇源愤怒地看着对方，似乎都在想当初怎么会和这个人结婚，于是记忆不自觉就回到了两人刚认识的时候……
第1章(1)
温宁是肖崇源第五个相亲对象，当时门当户对又年龄相仿的女孩有好几个，温宁却是最特别的那一个。
只不过她的特别之处就在于她非常普通，和其余几个举手投足都透出上流社会贵气的女孩相比，温宁属于高挑清丽型，四肢修长、体型匀称，比例十分协调，五官虽然说不上漂亮，但气质清婉，皮肤又白，只可惜开口的时候露出牙齿矫正器，令她稍显逊色。
但肖崇源看中的就是她的逊色，长得不丑，因为戴矫正器所以也不美，重点是性格安静，不太爱说话。

他们已经坐下来十五分钟了，温宁还没有一句话超过十个字，多数时间都是低头用餐。
肖崇源默不作声地打量着她，很显然她也感受到了他的目光，因为温宁的耳朵很红，浅淡的红晕一直弥漫到纤细的脖颈处，她头都不敢抬，一直低头努力地切着牛排。
她的用餐礼仪不像别人那么好，显得有些紧张。
肖崇源饶有兴趣地瞧着她，半晌过后轻轻地说：“温小姐，你很饿吗？”
“咯当！”温宁手里的刀叉掉到餐盘上。
耳根处那点红晕瞬间染满了整张小脸，她终于抬起头，本想用笑容掩饰尴尬，但想到自己戴着矫正器又不自在地抿住唇，转而无辜地耸了耸肩。
肖崇源低下头，用手支着太阳穴无声一笑，接着将自己眼前已经切好的牛排送到温宁的眼前，把她那盘拿过来。
温宁一愣，疑惑地看着他。
肖崇源从手边的小篮里取出新的刀叉，“这是你今晚第一次这样正视我。”
温宁咬唇，有些抱歉地抿唇笑着。
肖崇源把刀叉递过去，“不要吃得太急，胃会胀。”
温宁低头看着切得大小正好的牛排，忽然觉得心头暖暖的，轻声说：“谢谢。”
看来这次相亲并不如她所想的那样难熬，刚刚肖崇源开口时，温宁还以为他是要嘲笑她吃得多，谁晓得原来他那么贴心地在为自己着想……
温宁默默地想，不禁感叹现在这种人帅多金又温柔的男人真的太少了，能遇到这种相亲对象真幸运，怪不得老妈要死要活地逼她来见面，但温宁也知道这个男人不会属于她。
其实换成是家里任何一个姊姊来相亲，成功率都比她高，为什么偏偏让她这个最不起眼的小女儿来呢？看到眼前这个几乎无懈可击的男人时，温宁就知道自己没希望，只盼着他别让她太丢脸就好，但现在的状况显然比她所想的好太多。
不过更出乎她意料的状况还在后面，吃过饭后，肖崇源贴心地把她送回了家。
“谢谢。”这是温宁今晚说最多次的一句话，她开门下车，小心地关上车门。
只见肖崇源把头探了过来，“明天我来接你，还是这个时间。”
“我……”
“我知道你刚刚毕业，最近没有事做。”

所以她就要和他去约会？
“那么，明天见。”肖崇源笑着升上车窗，接着扬长而去。
温宁因为他温柔又不容置疑的口气而有些惊讶，但更惊讶的是他居然又约自己出去了，他该不会是审美观有问题吧？还是说妖艳的美女见得太多，想试试她这种清新型的？
虽然满腹疑窦，但温宁似乎没有拒绝这个优质男人的理由，于是两人陆陆续续见了几次面，确立关系之后，接着两人就在双方家长的催促下，订了婚又结了婚。
前后加在一起都没超过三个月，是名符其实的闪婚，温宁就这样半推半就地结了婚，即使她才二十二岁，大学毕业都还没来得及找工作，居然就把老公给找到了。
新婚之夜时，温宁还处于懵懂的状态。
“阿宁，还没好？”
“好了好了！”
肖崇源的声音把温宁从神游中拉了回来，她赶紧裹上浴袍，头发都还没吹就拉开浴室门，才刚想迈出去就被门前的那个身影吓得缩回来。
肖崇源就堵在门口，浴袍的衣襟敞开着，露出如玉的胸膛，温宁立刻垂下眼，却又看到他下面只穿了条宽松的四角裤。
“抱歉，我是不是太慢了？”温宁裹紧了浴袍，抬了抬头，抿着唇拘谨地笑。
“嗯。”肖崇源想也没想。
温宁一愣，咬了咬唇，“抱歉。”
“没关系，那么……”肖崇源看了看她。
“哦哦。”温宁连忙闪到一边。
肖崇源走进去，门还没关上就脱下了浴袍，温宁瞥了他肌肉结实的背脊一眼，连忙转过身走开。
他们所住的公寓每层楼只有一户，走出电梯就是客厅，面积足足有四个普通公寓那么大，温宁慢慢地晃到卧室，坐在梳妆台前惊讶地看着上面摆着的各种保养品，依次拿起来研究每种保养品的作用和用法，实在是太复杂了，她从来没用过这么多种保养品。
温宁挑了几种拍到脸上，感觉都还不错。
护肤完毕后温宁离开卧室，见肖崇源已经冲完澡，正准备往书房走。
肖崇源看了温宁一眼便走进去，半分钟过后又想起什么似的走出来，“我还有些事情要做，你先睡吧。”

“哦。”
肖崇源看她还没有离开的意思，便又说：“晚安。”
温宁点了点头，看来这就是她的新婚之夜了，不过也好，她紧张得要死了。
温宁回到卧室，换上睡衣后就钻进被窝，新床令她有些不适应，辗转了一会后才睡着。
本以为这一夜会这么平静地过去，但睡到一半时，她迷迷糊糊地觉得脖子上热热的，睁开眼睛之后依旧是一片漆黑，但脖子上热热的东西还在动，并且有逐渐下移的趋势。
content_en:
Wen Ning is Wen Ning's second sister. She disliked Xiao Chongyuan before they got married. After their divorce, she made things difficult for her. She used the power of the Wen family several times to cause trouble for Xiao's company, both covertly and overtly.
But it didn't cause any big losses. He was too careless and petty, "It's already been two years..."
"I'm sorry, I've always had a good memory."
"Then please remember how good the Wen family was to you."
"You reminded me." Xiao Chongyuan nodded as if he suddenly understood, and completely suppressed all the false smiles, "When the Wen family chose to cheat in order to marry the Xiao family, did they ever think about distinguishing public from private?"
"You..." Wen Ning looked at him in disbelief, unable to bear it, "You really haven't changed at all."
Xiao Chongyuan smiled softly, "You have changed a lot compared to before marriage."
Wen Ning was successfully irritated by him. Like an angry kitten, she almost scratched his face with her claws. "After so long, you still bring this matter up. You are really the most, most, most, most stingy man I have ever seen!"
Xiao Chongyuan also stood up and confronted her across the desk, "Do you, a woman, know who you are yelling at?"
Wen Ning stretched his neck, "In the final analysis, I was deceived by your gentle appearance. If my parents hadn't liked you, I wouldn't have married you, a stingy guy, so easily."
"Do you think I am willing to marry you?"
"So aren't we divorced? I don't want to see you again!"
"Then why are you still here?"
Wen Ning was choked, stunned for a while and secretly yelled, "Oh no, how could she forget what she was here to do!"
The two people who were at war with each other instantly stopped talking, and no one spoke for a while. The familiar quarrel made the two of them couldn't help but think of the past. At that time, they had been arguing like this, and the content of the argument was exactly the same as before.
Wen Ning and Xiao Chongyuan looked at each other angrily, as if they were wondering how they could marry this person in the first place, so their memories unconsciously returned to the time when they first met...
Chapter 1(1)
Wen Ning was Xiao Chongyuan's fifth blind date. At that time, there were several girls of similar age and well-matched status, but Wen Ning was the most special one.
But what's special about her is that she is very ordinary. Compared with the other girls who exude upper-class elegance in every gesture, Wen Ning is tall and beautiful, with slender limbs, a well-proportioned body, and very well-coordinated proportions. Although her facial features are not beautiful, she has a graceful temperament and white skin. Unfortunately, her dental braces are exposed when she opens her mouth, which makes her slightly inferior.
But what Xiao Chongyuan valued was her inferiority. She was not ugly, and she was not beautiful because she wore braces. The key point was that she had a quiet personality and didn't like to talk much.
They had been sitting down for fifteen minutes, and Wen Ning had not spoken more than ten words, and spent most of the time eating with his head down.
Xiao Chongyuan looked at her silently, and it was obvious that she also felt his gaze, because Wen Ning's ears were very red, and a light blush spread all the way to her slender neck. She did not dare to raise her head, and kept her head down while working hard to cut the steak.
Her dining etiquette is not as good as others and she seems a little nervous.
Xiao Chongyuan looked at her with interest, and after a while he said softly: "Miss Wen, are you hungry?"
"Crack!" The knife and fork in Wen Ning's hand fell onto the dinner plate.
The blush at the base of her ears instantly filled her entire little face. She finally raised her head. She wanted to cover up her embarrassment with a smile, but when she thought about wearing corrective devices and pursed her lips uncomfortably, she shrugged innocently.
Xiao Chongyuan lowered his head, supported his temples with his hands and smiled silently, then brought the steak that had been cut in front of him to Wen Ning, and took her plate over.
Wen Ning was stunned and looked at him doubtfully.
Xiao Chongyuan took out a new knife and fork from the small basket at hand, "This is the first time you look at me like this tonight."Wen Ning bit his lip and smiled apologetically.
Xiao Chongyuan handed over the knife and fork, "Don't eat too hastily, or your stomach will bloate."
Wen Ning looked down at the steak that was cut to a perfect size, and suddenly felt warm in his heart, and said softly: "Thank you."
It seemed that this blind date was not as difficult as she thought. When Xiao Chongyuan opened his mouth just now, Wen Ning thought he was going to laugh at her for eating too much. Who knew that he was actually thinking about herself so thoughtfully...
Wen Ning thought silently, and couldn't help but sigh that there are really too few handsome, rich and gentle men like this nowadays. It's so lucky to meet such a blind date. No wonder her mother wanted to force her to meet him, but Wen Ning also knew that this man would not belong to her.
In fact, if any sister in the family came for a blind date, the success rate would be higher than hers. Why should she, the most inconspicuous little daughter, be chosen? When Wen Ning saw the almost invulnerable man in front of her, she knew there was no hope for her. She just hoped that he would not embarrass her too much, but the current situation was obviously much better than she thought.
But something even more surprising to her was yet to come. After dinner, Xiao Chongyuan thoughtfully sent her home.
"Thank you." This was the sentence Wen Ning said the most tonight. She opened the door and got out of the car and carefully closed the door.
Xiao Chongyuan poked his head over and said, "I'll pick you up tomorrow, at this time."
"I..."
"I know you just graduated and have nothing to do recently."
So she's going on a date with him?
"Well, see you tomorrow." Xiao Chongyuan smiled and raised the car window, then walked away.
Wen Ning was a little surprised by his gentle and unquestionable tone, but he was even more surprised that he actually asked her out again. Could it be that he had a problem with aesthetics? Or have you seen too many beauties and want to try something fresh like her?
Although full of doubts, Wen Ning seemed to have no reason to reject this quality man, so the two met several times one after another. After establishing a relationship, the two got engaged and married at the urging of their parents.
It didn't take more than three months together. It was a real flash marriage. Wen Ning got married half-heartedly and half-heartedly. Even though she was only twenty-two years old and had not even had time to find a job after graduating from college, she actually found her husband.
On their wedding night, Wen Ning was still in a state of confusion.
"An Ning, are you still not feeling well?"
"Okay, okay!"
Xiao Chongyuan's voice brought Wen Ning back from her fugue. She quickly wrapped herself in a bathrobe and opened the bathroom door before her hair was dry. Just as she was about to step out, she was frightened by the figure in front of the door and shrank back.
Xiao Chongyuan was blocking the door. The skirt of his bathrobe was open, revealing his jade-like chest. Wen Ning immediately lowered his eyes, but saw that he was only wearing a pair of loose boxer briefs underneath.
"Sorry, was I too slow?" Wen Ning tightened his bathrobe, raised his head, and pursed his lips with a reserved smile.
"Yeah." Xiao Chongyuan didn't even think about it.
Wen Ning was stunned and bit his lip, "Sorry."
"It doesn't matter, then..." Xiao Chongyuan looked at her.
"Oh." Wen Ning quickly stepped aside.
Xiao Chongyuan walked in and took off his bathrobe before the door was closed. Wen Ning glanced at his muscular back and quickly turned around and walked away.
There was only one apartment on each floor of the apartment they lived in. Stepping out of the elevator was the living room, which was as big as four ordinary apartments. Wen Ning slowly walked to the bedroom, sat in front of the dressing table and looked at the various skin care products on it in surprise. She picked them up one by one to study the functions and uses of each skin care product. It was too complicated. She had never used so many kinds of skin care products.
Wen Ning picked a few and slapped them on his face, and they all felt pretty good.
After finishing the skin care, Wen Ning left the bedroom and saw that Xiao Chongyuan had finished taking a shower and was about to go to the study.
Xiao Chongyuan glanced at Wen Ning and walked in. Half a minute later, he walked out as if he had remembered something, "I still have some things to do, so you can go to sleep first."
"oh. "
Seeing that she had no intention of leaving, Xiao Chongyuan said again: "Good night. "
Wen Ning nodded. It seemed that this was her wedding night, but it was okay, she was extremely nervous.
Wen Ning returned to the bedroom, put on her pajamas and got into bed. She was a little uncomfortable with the new bed, and she tossed and turned for a while before falling asleep.
She thought the night would pass so peacefully, but halfway through her sleep, she felt vaguely hot on her neck. When she opened her eyes, it was still dark, but the hot thing on her neck was still moving and had a tendency to move downwards.
